node.title: Re^2: Use of special character "*" to retrieve the contents
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: It's important to note there is a difference between [doc://readdir]/[doc://glob] and [doc://File::Find]/[man://find]: the latter recurses into subdirectories as well. As for running external commands, I wrote about that, including the potential security risks, at length [id://1180578|here]. At the very least I would recommend using something like [mod://IPC::System::Simple]'s capturex, e.g. my @files = capturex("find",$path,qw/ ( -name *.ksh -o -name *.txt ) /);
